value.answer: Oakville doesn't have a Costco open yet. The first one is going up on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, with fall 2027 as the target. For now the closest open ones are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St and in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. I can't check drive times from where you are, so Burlington or Mississauga will depend on which part of Oakville you're in.
